note: Planned illustrations. The scenes already reference these asset names; the app shows its drawn storybook placeholder until each image is added to StuffyLand/Assets.xcassets as <asset>.imageset/<asset>.jpg (1200x720 for scenes).
style: Landscape Stuffy Land storybook illustration, 1200x720. Textured, painterly children's fantasy with tactile plush fabric and stitched seams, warm amber light, plum, lavender and gold palette. Human Opal is a young girl with shoulder-length dirty-blonde curls. Lolo is exactly one slender gray-and-tan sloth lovey with a cream-tan face and dark eye patches, never a bear. Langston is Opal's visibly taller, bigger older brother in a blanket cape and saucepan helmet. Every Aphmau plush is clearly a cat. Include only the named characters, once each. No words, labels or watermarks.

cover.prompt: Portrait 900x1350 storybook cover. Titanus, a gentle-eyed stone giant with a crystal crown and a golden bell, leans down over the mountains of Stuffy Land; small Opal holding Lolo looks up at him from the meadow, with Langston in his saucepan helmet beside her. A tiny star glows near the giant's shoulder. Leave clear space at the top for the title.

scenes.alt: Langston dangles upside down from a tree by one foot while Coatl gently lowers the branch and Opal and Lolo watch, laughing.
scenes.prompt: A bright morning meadow with marshmallow clouds. Langston hangs upside down from a tree branch by one foot, his blanket cape wrapped round his head and his saucepan helmet dangling from a smaller branch. Coatl, a gentle giant turtle with his shell on his back, gently lowers the branch. Opal holds Lolo and giggles; Axey, a pink axolotl plush, bounces nearby.

scenes.alt: The giant Titanus leans over the mountains with glowing purple eyes, a crown of crystals and a golden bell, while the tiny friends look up from the meadow.
scenes.prompt: The sky has gone dark. Titanus, an enormous stone giant taller than the mountains, with stone shoulders, glowing purple eyes, arms like bridges, dark armour and a crown of jagged crystals, leans over the mountains. A giant golden bell hangs round his neck. Far below in the meadow, a glowing heart-shaped crystal floats above a small pedestal. Tiny Opal holding Lolo, Langston in his saucepan helmet, and Coatl look up. Awe, not terror: he is grand and a little sad-eyed.

scenes.alt: Opal hugs Lolo as friends float up into the sky, and a glowing moon-shaped shield gathers them together while Coatl stays planted on the ground.
scenes.prompt: After the giant bell rings, Stuffy Land friends float into the air above the meadow: Opal hugging Lolo, Langston holding Frosted Kitty (a donut cat), Finley holding Stella (two fluffy white doodle girls). Nebula Johnny, a cosmic cat, spreads a glowing moon-shaped shield bubble around them. Coatl stays firmly planted below. Whimsical, gentle, a little silly.

scenes.alt: Behind a waterfall, Opal, Lolo, Coatl, Finley and Stella study old carvings of a giant protecting a little star.
scenes.prompt: Inside a cave behind a shimmering waterfall, ancient carvings glow faintly on the stone: a giant holding a small glowing star, protecting many tiny creatures; the giant standing alone; a golden bell. Opal and Lolo study them. Coatl's underside buttons glow softly. Finley holds a detective notebook; Stella sniffs a gold fragment on the floor.

scenes.alt: Through a fortress window at dusk, Axey and Aaron-y watch Titanus sitting beside an empty stone cradle, humming a sad lullaby.
scenes.prompt: Dusk. Through a tall purple-glowing window of a mountain fortress, we see Titanus sitting on the floor beside an empty stone cradle, his huge head bowed, humming. In the foreground, peeking over the window ledge: Axey the pink axolotl and Aaron-y, a gray-and-black wolf-like spy cat in a black hoodie with red ear and tail highlights. Tender and quiet.

scenes.alt: Opal, Lolo and friends ride a raft up a sparkling river that flows uphill toward a mountain fortress.
scenes.prompt: A sparkling magical river flows UPHILL toward a mountain fortress with purple windows. Water Kitty and Mermaid Kitty guide it. On a leaf raft: Opal holding Lolo, Langston, Axey, Finley and Stella. Stella points her nose at a golden glint under the water. Joyful and adventurous.

scenes.alt: The Dragon Couple carries Opal and Lolo around a giant cracked golden bell at the top of the fortress tower.
scenes.prompt: High above the clouds, the Dragon Couple fly together: an entirely purple boy dragon-cat and a dark-blue girl dragon-cat with a light-blue gem. Opal, holding Lolo, rides on one. They circle a gigantic golden bell at the top of a fortress tower; a long crack runs down the bell and a tiny round door sits near its base. Windswept and wondrous.

scenes.scene: The throne and I have no heart of my own
scenes.alt: Titanus sits on a stone throne holding the glowing Heart of Stuffy Land, with an empty stone cradle behind him, as Opal steps forward.
scenes.prompt: A vast throne room inside the mountain fortress. Titanus sits on a giant stone throne, cupping the glowing heart-shaped crystal of Stuffy Land in both enormous hands. Behind the throne, an empty stone cradle in a dark alcove. Small Opal steps forward holding Lolo, with Coatl and Langston behind her. Purple light, a hint of loneliness in the giant's face.

scenes.alt: Crumb-sized Onion Ring Kitty and rainbow Caterpillar Kitty pull together on a small golden lever inside the giant bell.
scenes.prompt: Inside the brass workings of a giant bell, enormous gears all around. Onion Ring Kitty, shrunk to crumb size, and Caterpillar Kitty, a tiny cat with rainbow segments each a different colour, wrap around a small golden lever and pull with all their might. A sliver of light from a tiny round door behind them. Heroic and tiny.

scenes.alt: Langston in his saucepan helmet and Frosted Kitty point up at a giant donut that has landed on Titanus's shoulder.
scenes.prompt: Throne room. A giant pink-frosted donut decoy has landed on Titanus's enormous shoulder and he stares at it, baffled. Below, Langston in a saucepan helmet and blanket cape points up triumphantly beside Frosted Kitty, a donut cat. Evil Queen Kitty, a purple cat with silver tiara and royal cape, stands on a broken piece of throne mid-speech. Comic and lively.

scenes.alt: Friends stand in a glowing circle around a stone cradle as a tiny star rises toward Titanus's open hand.
scenes.prompt: A circle of Stuffy Land friends stands round an empty stone cradle, each glowing with their own light: Opal with a glowing gemstone pendant and Lolo holding her hand, Coatl, Langston and Frosted Kitty, the Dragon Couple, and as many of the Aphmau cats as fit, each once. A tiny golden star rises out of the cradle toward Titanus's enormous open hand. A single huge golden tear on his cheek. The emotional climax: warm, golden, hopeful.
